body:
Founder real-time: "i think tipjar build is failing not sure."

Checked thoroughly, not assumed: fresh git clone into a scratch dir + raw gcc build (the exact
README-documented command) both succeeded cleanly, exit 0. The TIPJAR Step 3 code committed
earlier this session (5376a84) is genuinely fine.

Real gap found instead: this repo never had a build script at all, unlike every sibling repo in
this monorepo (REDGARDEN/GOLDENBAND/PRRJECT_FATBABY all have scripts/build.sh or a Makefile). If
`make` was what got tried -- the natural first move, matching every other repo's own convention --
it fails with "No targets specified and no makefile found," since no Makefile exists either. That
almost certainly reads as "the build is failing" even though the actual C code was never at
fault.

Added scripts/build.sh (builds + runs the physics smoke test, matching sibling repos'
convention), updated README.md to lead with it. Verified for real: ran the new script end to end,
clean build + test pass.
title: Build was never actually broken -- added the missing scripts/build.sh
